name: design-kit-dev
description: [DEV] Design foundations, web and product design, visual content, art and creative direction, and project-specific design rules.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Design principles, specialist decisions, direction, and reusable project rules.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides seven design skills: design-base applies color, perception, typography, space, interaction, motion, and repetition principles; web-designer shapes page communication and responsive presentation; product-designer handles tasks, flows, states, and recovery; visual-content-designer composes banners, editorial visuals, and social series; art-director establishes visual language; creative-director develops messages, concepts, and connected touchpoints; project-design-rules maintains project direction, foundations, and reusable patterns. Select the role needed for the task; the layers are not a mandatory execution or approval sequence.
defaultPrompt: Use $design-kit-dev:design-base to apply design principles to contrast, complementary colors, hierarchy, typography, space, interaction, and contextual repetition.
Use $design-kit-dev:web-designer to design or review page communication, navigation, layout, and responsive presentation.
Use $design-kit-dev:product-designer to design or review user tasks, flows, interactions, interface language, states, and recovery.
Use $design-kit-dev:visual-content-designer to compose banners, card-news series, editorial visuals, and social graphics with coherent messaging and repetition.
Use $design-kit-dev:art-director to establish a visual concept and consistent language across imagery, typography, color, composition, and surfaces.
Use $design-kit-dev:creative-director to define the audience, key message, central idea, and connected experience across channels.
Use $design-kit-dev:project-design-rules to discover, establish, record, or update a project's design direction, foundations, patterns, and repetition rules.
